title: ULPF ML feature record
description: DRAFT 0.1.0 (P6) — raised at the P6 boundary as a candidate sixth contract, not frozen. One record per normalized event, emitted alongside the OCSF JSONL (requirement h): the tuple (template_id, parameter_vector, timestamp, entity_ids). It is a projection of the normalized event and the span map — the routed family as the template, the parser's semantic fields in spec order as the parameters, the OCSF time, and the entity-bearing OCSF attributes — and carries no interpretation of its own. Runtime-produced; validated by both stacks like every other boundary document.

template_id.description: <pack_id>/<family_id>@<parser_hash>: the structure the event was routed to, pinned to the parser that produced the parameters.

parameter_vector.description: Same length and order as parameter_names: the coerced value, else the string value, else null when the field did not participate in this event.

entity_ids.description: Entity-bearing attributes present on the event, by a fixed short name. Absent entities are omitted, never invented.
